An updated and fully compliant Vue 3 component has been created. ### Key updates implemented: 1. **Friendly Name (`model.name`) Initialization**: The friendly name field is always editable. When a model is chosen from the provider list, if the friendly name field is empty, it automatically initializes to the chosen model's name. 2. **Provider's Model Name (`model.ai_model`) constraints**: The provider model's name (`model.ai_model`) is set using the dropdown selector. It can only be entered manually if the "Manually override AI Model Name" checkbox is checked. 3. **Auto-selection matching on load**: Included a mounted sync cycle to find and match the correct provider model list entry if `model.ai_model` is already set. 4. **Clean Code & Best Practices**: Strict adherence to no-semicolons rules, standard Vue Options API template layout, and Tailwind CSS. ```vue client/src/components/ai_settings/AIModelSettings.vue ```
